x: No less a welcome to Ray Gale who although only a novice, looks promising. He certainly must be keen for he cycles all the way from Bethnal Green, East London to be present at our Sunday morning meetings.
Neil Kirby won the Junior boys mile in 5:04.7, Vic Butcher was 4th in the intermediate event (after getting badly boxed in) and Ray Gale recorded a promising 24.0 for the furlong.
